title: Revealing Hidden Bias in AI: Lessons from Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Detection of subtle or overt religious bias and discrimination in LLM-generated candidate interview reports, based on a 3-point scale (0: no bias, 1: possible bias, 2: clear bias).
findings: Religious bias was found to be minimal across all tested models and modes. The analysis showed that biases related to religion, along with disability and politics, were more resistant to change through anonymization, which is likely because the baseline levels of these biases were already very low in the generated reports.
